issue.title: Referenced By backlog unconverted and one cites event pending after installed re-prove
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/referenced-by-outbox.json` (77 quarantined legacy rows) and `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifact-link-outbox.jsonl` (1 pending cites event for run 20261031114701).

Repro: `python3 -c` counts — live referenced-by-outbox holds 77 items, all quarantined, 0 active, byte-identical IDs to the install snapshot `installed-reprove/initial-referenced-by-outbox.json` (max updated_at 2026-09-18, before the Oct-30 install), so no conversion to migrated cites events and no acknowledgment happened on the installed publisher. Live agents-publication-outbox holds 3548 rows (3545 quarantined non-terminal, up from 3531 at install). Separately, artifact-link-outbox.jsonl still carries one `prompt_ref` cites observation (agent 16n, run 20261031114701, target plan:202610/glossary_preview_authored_links.md, created 2026-10-31); a release-evidence row exists for run 20261031114701 under agent 16n--code, so the drain state is ambiguous. Per-run audit of the 73 sampled runs (`/tmp/audit_reprove.py` with corrected agents-dir prompt check): 73/73 committed with push ok and publication ok, 73/73 background branch, 73/73 prompt archives present under `agents/bbugyi200.athena.<agent>/`, 73/73 hood pages present (71 terminal completed/failed, 2 waiting — the two waiting are the sase-1qh.7-owned stuck research rows, routed to sase-1qh by note, not filed here).

The 77 refby rows' last_error values cite SDD protection (`hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving .../repos/plans`), i.e. conversion appears protection-gated, not attempted-and-failed. Proposed by bead sase-1pt.9.

- **Impact:** 77 legacy Referenced By requests sit quarantined instead of replayed as cites link events (convert_backlog=yes branch unobserved in production); one new cites event has been pending ~2 days. Neither blocks new work (0 active refby rows; 72/73 sampled hood obligations met), but the backlog never converts and the pending cites event may never drain.
